W.note: Pastel violet, teal and pink halo blooms behind the pill on a 360ms enter and a fast 180ms leave, with a separate 460ms glow curve, and it animates only opacity and transform with focus and reduced-motion handled.

X.note: The strongest visual polish on dark, with a gradient sheen and glow on a 700ms ease-dream, but it animates filter and box-shadow, runs a decorative infinite orb float, and uses backdrop-filter, so it costs more to render.

Y.note: The teal-to-pink gradient drifts dreamily, but it animates background-position with a symmetric 620ms curve that lags on leave, and the mobile Dreamline card overflows the 390px width so text and the Check-out tile are clipped.

Z.note: The most disciplined build, with asymmetric 170ms leave and preset enter curves, opacity and transform only, gated hover, focus-visible parity and reduced-motion handling, but the blue glow is subtler and less ethereal than W.
